## a2278025ab10

**Concrete shortcut.** All four canonical pairs place the three loose
components left-to-right under the corresponding color-1, color-2, and color-3
frames. The wrong rule “sort loose components and frames left-to-right, then
center the kth component in the kth frame” exactly reproduces all four canonical
outputs while ignoring hole count.

The current generator does emit a refutation. At seed `1`, sample index `0`,
difficulty `medium`, the generated input passes its `self_check`. Positional
pairing maps component colors `(6,8,4)` to frame colors `(3,1,2)`, while actual
hole counts map them to `(1,3,2)`. I applied the selected canonical Racket rule
(hash `7844743e6a8c`) with the supported command; its output differs from the
positional rival. Exact input, rival output, Racket receipt, hashes, and the
reusable probe are under `checks/audit/a2278025ab10/`.

This generator nevertheless lacks an executable contract proving that complete
lessons expose the distinction: semantic gate fails for no declared contract.
Additional reproduced blockers are missing `RULE_HASH`, zero canonical-profile
support in 60 draws, dead/overlapping texture declarations, and more than 15,000
reported exact-override findings; see
`checks/audit/a2278025ab10-{lint,defect_lint,profile_floor,semantic_gate,override}/`.
Diversity and rule smoke pass, so the finding is specifically about authority
binding, distribution/controls, and teaching identifiability—not inability to
run the rule. No fix was applied because this was an audit-only target.
